bead.title: Raise terminal_retention_ms default from 60s to 1h
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The 60-second terminal retention default is too short once niflheim owns queue history (TD-008): terminal items must linger long enough to cover idempotency retry windows and give the change-record emission consumer catch-up margin before reap. Operator direction (2026-07-03): leave items in the queue longer.

CURRENT STATE
- crates/pqueue-core/src/domain.rs:652-653 default_terminal_retention_ms() returns 60_000; serde default at :631-632; validation > 0 at :685-687; doc-test defaults at :1399.

PROPOSED FIX
Change the default to 3_600_000 (1 hour) per TD-008 (docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md, Retention section — deliberately not days: terminal items inflate the resident projection set linearly and niflheim owns long-term history). Keep per-queue override and validation. Update doc-tests.

NON-SCOPE
- Reap/emission-frontier coupling and lag metrics (separate emission bead).
- Any projection memory-limit enforcement.
bead.acceptance:
1. cargo test -p pqueue-core core_domain_tests passes with an assertion that default_terminal_retention_ms() == 3_600_000.
2. Serde back-compat: a persisted QueueDefinition missing the field rehydrates to 3_600_000 (extend queue_definition_serde_defaults_terminal_retention, domain.rs:1628).
3. cargo test -p pqueue-core passes.
